blocks.title: Iteration
blocks.text: Iteration means repeating a process to get closer to a desired result, making changes based on feedback until the final outcome is reached, as when a cook adjusts and tastes a dish until it is right.
Designing a school-event logo: share a first design, revise colours and shapes from classmates' feedback, ask again and refine until everyone approves.
